full_page.content:
St. Bonaventure's Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit, Mich.
June 3, 1927
Rev. Mother Augustine The Pines Chatham, Ontario
Rev. Dear Mother Me. Augustine:
Many thanks for your kind favor of May 28th. I in- scribed Mr. Panyard's name as requested and am sending his certificate under separate cover ... ..... I have not the least doubt that the trouble he finds himself in is meant to be a blessing in dis- guise .... If his friends promise something specially pleasing to God, and surely if he himself promised weekly Communion for 6 months - or at least month- ly - for a year, everything will be OK ....
Fr. Solanus, OFM Cap.
